text.p: Tropical storm Levi is located well south of Okinawa in the latest report but it is moving towards the north-northeast. It is expected to have winds up to 50 mph as it tracks just southeast of Okinawa during the next 24-36 hours. The island can expect locally heavy rainshowers, gusty winds and strong seas during the period. This could lead to beach errosion during this period.

Tropical depression 6w will mostly threaten shipping during the next 48-72 hours. It tracks from near 14n/158e to 24n/156e during the period. Top winds increase from 30 mph to 55 mph during the next 48 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
